description: This file contains implementation of CUDA-based RNN functionalities for PyTorch, including mode handling, dropout state management, and a module class for cuDNN RNN integration.

classes.name: Unserializable
classes.description: A class to represent an unserializable object, mainly used for dropout state management.

classes.name: ContextProp
classes.description: A class to manage getter and setter functions for context properties like fp32 precision.

classes.name: CudnnRNNModule
classes.description: A module class that wraps cuDNN RNN functionalities, including dropout state initialization and mode setting.

methods.name: get_cudnn_mode
methods.description: Converts mode string to corresponding cuDNN RNN mode integer.

methods.name: init_dropout_state
methods.description: Initializes dropout state for cuDNN RNN, managing dropout probability and seed.
